lecture_summary: The lecture develops ideal mass–spring simple harmonic motion: sinusoidal position, velocity and acceleration, restoring force, amplitude, phase, period, frequency, angular frequency, and spring-system energy conservation. Its problem-solving examples include reading oscillation parameters from a graph, measuring displacement from a shifted equilibrium, evaluating position and velocity at a specified time, interpreting the motion from signs, and finding maximum speed using energy.
